messages.text:
Yes, you can disconnect the iPhone now: no test is using it and none will start until you reconnect it.
- The phone has been free since 12:56Z (UTC); nothing is loaded on it from us.
- The phone heat test (P-130, the last two heat runs) is paused; I told its runner not to start.
- Mac and Simulator work goes on without the phone: image work, nav, countdown and toolbar checks.
- The hero-park phone checks (P-140) were not ready yet, so they lose no time.
- When you plug it back in, write here; I check the connection and the robot-swipe driver (WDA) before any test.

What you need to do: unplug the phone whenever you like, and tell me here when it is back.
Let's combine the fixes that already do rendering measurement into best build. then try to measure at once, can we ?

Yes. One combined build, "v9.2", measured once against today's best build; int-v8 builds and measures it.
- In: every fix whose rendering count test (Chrome counts or Simulator layout/style per frame) already passed.
- Candidates: the v9.1d base (skip phone-off scroll work), people-word, hero-park, nav fade, nav colour, toolbar, countdown roll.
- A fix whose check is still running joins only if it passes before the 15:00Z (UTC) freeze; the rest wait for v9.3.
- Not in: image changes; they change the look, so they stay a proposal for you to try first.
- One measurement: Chrome counts and Simulator for the whole page, then one phone test and one blind swipe A/B.
- That one swipe test replaces the separate per-fix finger tests, including hero-park's.
- Downside: one number for all fixes. If any section gets worse, int-v8 removes fixes one at a time to find which.
- The phone parts wait until you reconnect the iPhone (you disconnected it at 13:49Z).

What you need to do: nothing now. Reconnect the phone when you can; the swipe A/B comes to your console after the Mac checks.

Update on the combined build you asked for: it is now the current best build (v9.1d) with no extra fixes, and its one-time measurement starts now on the Mac.
- The three candidate add-ons each changed a few pixels outside the part they fix, so by your look-alike rule none can join without your OK:
| add-on | what it smooths | why it is out |
|---|---|---|
| people-word | the moving word in the headline | 3 tiny pixel spots outside the word |
| nav-fade | the top-menu fade | a bright 4 px spot near the top in the Simulator |
| menu-blur (U2) | the menu blur | a small spot in the menu bar |
- Each can come back later through its own test.
- The phone part (one block plus one blind swipe test) still waits for the iPhone to be reconnected.
What you need to do: nothing now. Reconnect the iPhone when you want the phone part to run.

The Mac part of the combined-build test is done: v9.2 is no worse than today's site anywhere we measured.
| check (Mac) | v9.2 vs today |
|---|---|
| Chrome page work while scrolling | 187 vs 289 animation callbacks per second (less) |
| Simulator layout per frame while scrolling | about 6 % less |
| Simulator at rest | same |
- One check first missed most of the scroll (a script bug); it was fixed and re-run, and a separate reader confirmed every number.
- v9.2 is the current best build with no add-ons (the three add-ons stayed out, as I wrote above).
- Left: the phone part, one block (about 70 min) plus one blind swipe test with you.
What you need to do: reconnect the iPhone when you have about 70 minutes for the phone part.

Got it: the iPhone is back on the cable and ready (debug link up, robot finger ready, battery about 35 °C).
- Next on the phone: the v9.2 build check (P-142 part 2, about 70 min of robot-finger runs), then a short blind swipe test for you on the console.
- After that: the end-of-page images check (P-145), then the deck check.
What you need to do: leave the iPhone plugged in and unlocked. Your swipe step will appear in "Your steps" when it is ready.
